note: The private half of tests/data/countdown_hold_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the countdown hold (docs/MATCH_COUNTDOWN.md, 'How long a seat can hold the countdown'; docs/SERVER.md, --countdown-hold-seconds) for tools/mutate.py: the most that a match that has not begun to play is held, in all, for seats that are away (the nearer of the hold and the cap, until the first turn is sealed), then every seat that is not present is dropped; the default of a minute; a match that plays, a restored match and a spec without a hold are exempt; the setting's range and its status keys. Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/countdown_hold_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 1500. Every mutant must be caught: each breaks one rule of those pages. The soak S3.307 (24 rooms, leave and rejoin cycles) is run on the unmutated tree only: it is long, and S3.305 and S2.58 hold each rule.
